pages.text: The strongest thing OreSpawn ever made. It knows.

pages.title: Finding Him
pages.text: The King holds court at the King Altar on $(l:orespawn_integrations:dimensions/beyond_the_tunnels)Utopia$()'s plains, and his five-level Challenge Towers rise across the world — every floor's vault richer, and meaner, than the last.$(p)Our pack plants a Waystone shrine at the gate of every tower, altar and royal tree: activate it first, and defeat costs you a walk instead of a war.
Nine King Parts lie buried among the world's hidden spawn blocks. Dig, combine, place... regret.

pages.title: The Prize
pages.text: Fell him and the Royal tier is yours: every kill yields a full set of Royal armor and the Royal Guardian Sword.$(p)That is the only source of Royal gear in this pack — no recipe, no shortcut. Just the King, a preposterous health bar, and you.

pages.title: What They Leave Behind
pages.text: The Royal tier is currency now. His $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/spell_scrolls)Lightning scrolls$() carry a rare max-level jackpot, the Harbinger's anvil $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/tempered_majesty)tempers his sword$() harder still, and surplus Royal gear $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/court_economy)melts back into queen scales$(). He may even hand over a $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/soul_shards)soul shard$() with 64 kills pre-signed.$(p)The King funds the Court. The Court never confiscates.
